description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
These are the Suzuki OEM Protector Cap Attachment Clips.
They attach the Front Bumper / Metal Bar to the plastic end caps.
It takes 2 for each cap.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 4 – Clips, Protector Cap
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
